levelFreshnessNote: Hourly CWC telemetry averaged per month. The WRIS level feed has been frozen basin-wide since 04 Jun 2026 - the series ends there until the source resumes.

extraStations.name: Kabini at Muthankera
extraStations.coordinatesNote: From Paani Earth's validated CWC location set (Kabini_CWC_Locations.gpkg), reprojected to WGS84. The same file's other two stations reproject to the coordinates already shipped, which is what makes this one trustworthy.
extraStations.note: The upstream-most CWC gauge on the Kabini, in Wayanad. It sits outside the Karnataka share this atlas clips to and inside the basin the atlas draws. Its discharge and level series have not been fetched yet: India-WRIS, the only source for CWC observations, was unreachable when this was built. The station is on the map so the gauge network is shown as it exists; the readings attach on the next run that reaches the source.

_statesNote: Kerala/Wayanad is queried for the Kabini's own headwaters: the basin this atlas draws now extends across the border, and CCP00T8 is the upstream-most CWC gauge on the river. state/districts stay as the single-state shorthand the other basins use.
